description: This file defines the EndpointAwareReport interface within the OrangeHRM core reporting API module. It extends the Report interface and declares methods for preparing filter parameters, obtaining validation rules, and checking report accessibility, all in the context of handling specific API endpoints.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns a FilterParams object based on the provided EndpointProxy, encapsulating request-specific filtering criteria.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns a collection of parameter validation rules (ParamRuleCollection) for the given EndpointProxy, used to validate filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Evaluates whether the report is accessible via the provided EndpointProxy and throws a ForbiddenException if access is denied.
